name: FocusTrap
description: Constrains keyboard Tab and Shift+Tab focus cycling within a container. When deactivated with restoreFocus=true, returns focus to the previously focused element.

notes: When active, Tab cycles forward through focusable children; Shift+Tab cycles backward.
Focus is contained — pressing Tab on the last focusable element moves focus to the first, and vice versa.
When restoreFocus is true (default), focus returns to the element that was active when the trap was activated.
No visual style is added; the rendered div wrapper is transparent to layout.

active.description: Whether focus trapping is currently active.

restoreFocus.description: When true, focus returns to the previously focused element when active transitions to false.

children.description: A single child element that serves as the focus trap container.

className.description: Additional CSS class names applied to the wrapper div.

do: Use FocusTrap inside Modal, Drawer, and Popover to comply with ARIA dialog patterns.
Set active=false before unmounting to trigger restoreFocus cleanup.
dont: Do not nest FocusTrap instances — only the innermost active trap will receive keyboard events.
Do not rely on FocusTrap for click containment — it only intercepts keyboard Tab events.
